instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Read the posts I bookmarked or liked on X, newest first, with their full words, links and quoted posts", and give it which (Which saved posts to read.); account (Which of the person's X connections to read with, by its id (service_connection:x, or service_connection:x:<account>).).
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:read-my-saved-x-posts and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Reads the posts the person bookmarked or liked on X through X's API with the access token of their connected X account, newest first: each post's full words, who wrote it, when, its pictures, every real link it carries (not the short t.co form) and the post it quotes.
